title: Internalizing Externalities: Disclosure Regulation for Hydraulic Fracturing, Drilling Activity and Water Quality
affiliations: University of Navarra, IESE Business School,  and University of Padua

detail.title: Internalizing Externalities: Disclosure Regulation for Hydraulic Fracturing, Drilling Activity and Water Quality

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 676/2023
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Law Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Responding to the rise of hydraulic fracturing (HF) and risks to water quality, U.S. states mandated disclosure for HF wells. We study whether and how such targeting of corporate externalities with transparency regulation reduces environmental impact. We examine salt concentrations considered HF signatures and find significant reductions in surface water impact between 9-14%, mostly along the intensive margin. Consistent with that we document improvements in operator practices, including fewer wastewater spills. We unpack the transparency mechanism and show that transparency regulation enables social movements and increases public pressure, which in turn drives the documented changes in practices and water quality.

AI.tldr: 美国各州对水力压裂井实施强制性信息披露监管，研究发现该透明度法规使地表水盐浓度（水力压裂特征物）显著降低9-14%，主要通过改善运营商实践（如减少废水泄漏）实现，其机制在于透明度法规赋能社会运动、增加公众压力，从而驱动企业行为改变。
AI.research_question: 针对企业外部性的透明度监管是否以及如何减少环境危害？
AI.motivation: 回应水力压裂技术兴起带来的水质风险，以及美国各州对压裂井实施强制性信息披露的监管实践，探究透明度监管的实际环境效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 透明度监管理论；社会运动与公众压力机制；企业外部性治理理论。
AI.method: 实证分析：测量地表水中被视为水力压裂特征物的盐浓度变化；分析运营商实践改进（如废水泄漏次数）。
AI.findings: 透明度监管使地表水盐浓度（水力压裂特征物）显著降低9-14%，效应主要沿集约边际（intensive margin）发生；运营商实践改善，包括废水泄漏减少；透明度监管通过赋能社会运动、增加公众压力驱动上述变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了透明度监管减少企业外部性的具体机制——社会运动与公众压力的中介作用，为透明度监管的治理效果提供了因果证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了信息披露监管能够有效降低环境风险的实证依据，支持通过透明度监管替代或补充传统命令控制型环境规制。

AI.research_question: 如何利用公开市场数据对GNRC代币所对应的宝石储备进行独立、可复制的估值？
AI.motivation: 为代币化实物资产（宝石储备）提供透明、可验证的估值框架，解决加密货币领域实物资产估值缺乏标准化方法的问题。

title: Implied Loss Level and Attachment Tilt in CMBX
affiliations: Georgia State University

detail.title: Implied Loss Level and Attachment Tilt in CMBX
detail.abstract: CMBX tranche quotes describe a six-point price surface across the capital structure. For eachseries and day we fit a two-parameter risk-neutral Vasicek loss distribution to the AAA-through-BB stack and recover two coordinates: the implied loss level and the attachment tilt. Theloss level is largely captured by lower-stack prices, whereas the tilt is identified from relativeprices across the stack and separates broad up-stack repricing from first-loss concentration.Empirically, the 2020 selloff raised both the loss level and up-stack propagation, while the2023–2026 office/rate episode produced comparable or greater loss levels but sharper first-lossconcentration. Because the fitted object is a risk-neutral loss distribution over pool losses,it prices arbitrary attachment bands, generates exceedance curves and sensitivities, and mapsstress scenarios into internally consistent cross-tranche price changes.

AI.tldr: 本文利用两参数风险中性Vasicek损失分布拟合CMBX分层报价，提取隐含损失水平和附着倾斜度两个坐标，并应用于分析2020年抛售与2023-2026年办公/利率冲击的不同定价特征。
AI.research_question: 如何从CMBX分层报价中提取简洁的定价信息，以区分系统性损失上升与资本结构不同层级的相对定价变化？
AI.motivation: CMBX分层报价包含丰富的横截面信息，但现有分析往往仅关注单一层级；需要一个简约框架同时捕捉整体损失水平和跨层级相对定价结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险中性Vasicek损失分布模型，通过隐含损失水平（loss level）和附着倾斜度（attachment tilt）两个参数刻画整个资本结构的定价信息。
AI.method: 对每个CMBX系列和交易日，将AAA至BB层级报价拟合到两参数风险中性Vasicek损失分布，从中提取隐含损失水平和附着倾斜度。
AI.findings: 1) 损失水平主要由低层级价格决定；2) 倾斜度由跨层级相对价格识别，区分广泛的上层重新定价与首损集中度；3) 2020年抛售同时提高了损失水平和上层传播；4) 2023-2026年办公/利率冲击产生了相当或更大的损失水平，但首损集中度更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一个简约的两参数框架，将CMBX资本结构的横截面定价信息压缩为两个有经济含义的坐标，便于分析和比较不同时期的市场定价模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 该框架可为任意附着层定价、生成超越曲线和敏感性分析，并将压力情景映射为内部一致的跨层级价格变化，适用于风险管理与定价实践。

title: Debt Heterogeneity and Leverage Measurement: The Role of Operating Leases
affiliations: University of Bristol

detail.title: Debt Heterogeneity and Leverage Measurement: The Role of Operating Leases
detail.abstract: Empirical work on capital structure typically treats debt as homogeneous. This paper examines that assumption by focusing on operating leases. Using data for U.S. firms from 2012–2023, I show that operating lease obligations constitute a substantial proportion of corporate debt and that firms substitute between operating leases, bank debt and public debt in ways that do not preserve leverage. Operating lease intensity is strongly negatively associated with the leverage gap (actual minus target leverage). A one standard deviation increase in operating lease intensity is associated with a 6–8% reduction in the leverage gap, suggesting that firms with greater reliance on operating leases appear under-levered under conventional leverage measures. These findings imply that aggregate leverage measures may omit information contained in debt composition. The analysis spans the pre- and post-ASC 842 periods, allowing operating lease liabilities to be measured consistently and validated against recognised lease liabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文发现经营性租赁在公司债务中占很大比重，且公司会在经营性租赁、银行贷款和公共债务之间进行替代，这种替代不保持杠杆率不变。经营性租赁强度与杠杆缺口（实际杠杆减目标杠杆）显著负相关，标准偏差增加一个单位会使杠杆缺口减少6-8%，表明依赖经营性租赁的公司传统杠杆指标下显得杠杆不足。
AI.research_question: 将债务视为同质化的传统资本结构实证假设是否合理？经营性租赁如何影响公司的杠杆衡量和资本结构决策？
AI.motivation: 实证研究通常将债务视为同质的，但这种假设可能忽略不同债务工具之间的异质性，尤其是经营性租赁这类表外融资对资本结构的影响被低估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本结构理论（权衡理论）、债务异质性、表外融资与杠杆衡量偏差
AI.method: 使用2012-2023年美国公司数据，分析经营性租赁占公司债务的比例、不同债务工具之间的替代关系，以及经营性租赁强度与杠杆缺口之间的关系。研究覆盖ASC 842实施前后的时期，通过确认的租赁负债对经营性租赁负债进行一致性衡量和验证。
AI.findings: 1) 经营性租赁构成公司债务的很大一部分；2) 公司会在经营性租赁、银行贷款和公共债务之间进行替代，但这种替代不保持杠杆率不变；3) 经营性租赁强度与杠杆缺口（实际杠杆减目标杠杆）显著负相关，一个标准偏差增加与6-8%的杠杆缺口减少相关；4) 依赖经营性租赁的公司传统杠杆指标下显得杠杆不足；5) 合计杠杆指标可能遗漏债务构成中的信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了资本结构实证中将债务视为同质化的假设，揭示了债务构成（尤其是经营性租赁）对杠杆衡量和资本结构决策的重要影响，为权衡理论提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示研究者和实务工作者不能仅关注传统的杠杆指标，而应关注债务构成；为会计准则变化（ASC 842）下租赁负债的识别和衡量提供了实证依据。

title: From Computing Infrastructure to Labor Income Share: Evidence from China's "East Data, West Computing" Initiative
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Jacksonville State University and Jilin University (JLU)

detail.title: From Computing Infrastructure to Labor Income Share: Evidence from China's "East Data, West Computing" Initiative
detail.abstract: This paper examines how large-scale computing infrastructure investment shapes the functional distribution of income between labor and capital. Using China's “East Data, West Computing” initiative as a quasi-natural experiment, we exploit the geographic designation of eight national computing power hubs in a difference-in-differences design. We find that the initiative significantly increases labor income share, with gains driven entirely by non-executive employees and accompanied by a reduction in the within-firm pay gap. Three mechanisms account for this effect:technological advancement, financial facilitation, and human capital upgrading.Firms experiencing larger increases in labor income share further exhibit greater innovation, lower employee turnover, and higher employee productivity. Our findingsestablish computing infrastructure as a novel determinant of labor income share.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国“东数西算”工程作为准自然实验，采用双重差分法评估了大型计算基础设施投资对劳动收入份额的影响，发现该政策显著提升了劳动收入份额，且该效应完全由非高管员工驱动，并缩小了企业内部薪酬差距。机制包括技术进步、金融便利化和人力资本升级。
AI.research_question: 大规模计算基础设施投资如何影响劳动与资本之间的功能性收入分配？
AI.motivation: 计算基础设施（如数据中心）的大规模投资日益成为数字经济时代的核心议题，但其对收入分配——尤其是劳动收入份额——的影响尚缺乏系统性的因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 功能性收入分配理论、技术进步偏向性理论、人力资本理论、金融约束理论。
AI.method: 以中国“东数西算”工程中八个国家级计算枢纽的地理划分为准自然实验，采用双重差分法（DID）进行因果识别。
AI.findings: “东数西算”工程显著提升了劳动收入份额，该效应完全来自非高管员工，且降低了企业内部薪酬差距。机制是技术进步、金融便利化和人力资本升级。劳动收入份额提升更大的企业还表现出更强的创新能力、更低的员工流失率和更高的员工生产率。
AI.theory_contributions: 将计算基础设施确立为劳动收入份额的一个新颖决定因素，拓展了功能性收入分配的研究边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字基础设施建设中的收入分配效应提供因果证据，为政策制定者平衡技术进步与分配公平提供参考。

title: "Reconfiguring Land Governance in Jammu and Kashmir Post Independence"

detail.title: "Reconfiguring Land Governance in Jammu and Kashmir Post Independence"
detail.abstract:
Land has historically been constituted as one of the most complex and politically sensitive dimensions of governance in India, significantly influencing agricultural productivity, livelihoods, social equity, and economic development. Despite successive legislative and administrative reforms, challenges relating to land ownership, tenure security, and administration continue to shape policy reform debates. Within this broader landscape, Jammu and Kashmir presents a particularly significant case, owing to its distinctive trajectory in land governance since the pre-Independence period. During the Dogra rule, land ownership was characterized by highly concentrated estates, exploitative tenancy arrangements, and deeply unequal agrarian relations due to the benefits being usurped by the intermediary class comprising Jagirdars, Muafidars, and Chakdars, leaving cultivators with limited ownership rights and economic security. In the post-Independence period, the agrarian reforms introduced under the leadership of Sheikh Abdullah fundamentally transformed this structure by abolishing intermediary landlordism, redistributing land to the actual tillers, and establishing one of India's most comprehensive land-to-the-tiller regimes. These reforms were subsequently reinforced more strongly by the constitutional protections available under Articles 370 and 35A, which enabled the continuation of a region-specific land governance framework for several decades.

However, the abrogation of Articles 370 and 35A through the Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act (2019) marked a significant departure from this historical framework through the restructuring of land laws, ownership regulations, and administrative institutions governing land in the current Union Territory. While these reforms have been justified on the grounds of economic integration, broader investment opportunities, administrative uniformity, and enabling national development, they have also raised important policy concerns relating to agricultural land tenure security, administrative discretion, changing land ownership patterns, and the long-term protection of cultivators' rights. Against this backdrop, the policy brief identifies the erosion of agricultural land tenure security as the primary policy challenge in the UT, which subsequently has led to land-related disputes, opportunities for fraudulent transactions, and declining confidence in public institutions. Drawing upon constitutional provisions, legislative instruments, government notifications, academic literature, and policy reports, the brief traces the historical evolution of the region's land governance, evaluates the implications of the post 2019 reforms through a stakeholder-centered framework, and proposes a phased three-pillar reform package comprising GPS-based cadastral demarcation, conclusive state-guaranteed land titling, and voluntary dematerialisation of land records to strengthen legal certainty, reduce land-related disputes, enhance administrative efficiency, and promote equitable and sustainable land governance.

AI.tldr: 本文梳理了印度查谟和克什米尔地区土地治理的历史演变，分析了2019年废除第370条和35A条后土地改革的影响，指出农地保有权安全性下降是核心政策挑战，并提出了基于GPS地籍测绘、国家担保土地所有权和土地记录非物质化的三支柱改革方案。
AI.research_question: 2019年废除宪法第370条和35A条后，查谟和克什米尔地区的土地治理改革对农地保有权安全性产生了什么影响？如何构建更有效的土地治理框架？
AI.motivation: 查谟和克什米尔地区在2019年宪法地位变更后，土地法律和行政体系发生重大转变，引发了关于农地保有权安全、行政裁量权、土地所有权模式变化以及耕种者权利保护的争议，需要系统评估并提出政策建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者中心框架（stakeholder-centered framework），用于评估土地改革对不同群体的影响。
AI.method: 政策简报形式，基于宪法条款、立法文件、政府通知、学术文献和政策报告的综合分析。
AI.findings: 1）2019年后的改革导致农地保有权安全性下降；2）由此引发土地纠纷增加、欺诈交易机会增多、公众机构信任度降低；3）提出了GPS地籍测绘、国家担保土地确权、土地记录非物质化的三支柱改革方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过利益相关者中心框架系统评估了后2019年土地改革的影响，为理解宪法地位变更对地方土地治理的影响提供了分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了可操作的三支柱改革方案（GPS地籍测绘、国家担保土地确权、土地记录非物质化），以增强法律确定性、减少土地纠纷、提升行政效率、促进公平可持续的土地治理。

title: Production of Commodities by Means of Parts: Generative Structures, Modules, and Productive Possibilities

detail.title: Production of Commodities by Means of Parts: Generative Structures, Modules, and Productive Possibilities
detail.abstract: Production theory records feasible input-output quantities. This paper develops a generative representation beneath that record. A commodity is defined as a structured functional object, and production is represented by directed generative structures that transform parts, operations, and knowledge into modules and final commodities. The paper defines generative length, minimal generative complexity, organizational gain, socially normal recipes, and execution labels. It proves that the standard production set is a projection of generative production space, that this projection loses dynamic information about future productive possibilities, and that recipe-space productivity improvements admit an exact mechanism decomposition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种生成式生产表示方法，将商品定义为结构化功能对象，通过有向生成结构表示生产，证明了标准生产集是生成生产空间的投影，并提出了生成长度、最小生成复杂度、组织收益等概念。
AI.research_question: 如何超越传统的投入-产出生产理论，构建一种能够捕捉生产动态信息和未来生产可能性的生成式生产表示方法？
AI.motivation: 传统生产理论仅记录可行的投入-产出数量，但这种记录方式丢失了关于未来生产可能性的动态信息，需要一种更丰富的生成式表示来捕捉生产过程的深层结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成式生产理论：将商品定义为结构化功能对象，生产由有向生成结构表示，涉及部件、操作和知识向模块和最终商品的转化。
AI.method: 理论推导与证明：定义生成长度、最小生成复杂度、组织收益、社会正常食谱和执行标签等概念，并证明标准生产集是生成生产空间的投影等定理。
AI.findings: 标准生产集是生成生产空间的投影；该投影丢失了关于未来生产可能性的动态信息；食谱空间的生产率改进存在精确的机制分解。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了生成式生产理论，为传统生产理论提供了更深层的微观基础；揭示了生产集作为投影所丢失的动态信息；提供了生产率改进的机制分解方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解生产组织、知识积累和生产率提升提供了新的分析框架和工具；有助于企业优化生产结构和组织设计。

title:
Learning Governance and Capability Formation Under Uncertainty:

An IMPO Model of Experimentation-as-Search
affiliations: , Cranfield University - School of Management and Cranfield University

detail.title:
Learning Governance and Capability Formation Under Uncertainty:

An IMPO Model of Experimentation-as-Search

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: Approved by Cranfield CURES 10/1/23
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
Organizations increasingly rely on experimentation to navigate uncertainty. Yet scholars know little about how repeated experimentation becomes an enduring adaptive capability. This study addresses that gap. It examines how teams govern learning, rather than merely enact it, as they search for viable products and business models under uncertainty.

This study uses a two-phase qualitative design set within a highly structured experimentation environment, the U.S. National Science Foundation I-CORPS™ program. Phase 1 analyzes 40 semi-structured interviews through the Gioia methodology. Phase 2 triangulates nine complete cases using interviews, surveys, business model canvases, and archival artifacts.

The analysis yields an Input–Moderator–Process–Output (IMPO) model. In the model, founding mental models and contextual moderators shape an experimentation-as-search process. That process produces two distinct outputs: learning and behavioral, and venture value. Some teams move beyond single- and double-loop learning. They deliberately revise the rules that govern experimentation by redefining evidence thresholds, decision rights, and reflective practices. These revisions signal triple-loop learning and the formation of an adaptive capability.

The study introduces learning governance as a distinct construct and positions it as a microfoundation of dynamic capabilities. It explains how experimentation becomes a compoundable capability rather than a series of isolated tests. The model also travels beyond new ventures. It applies to corporate innovation teams, artificial intelligence implementation teams, deep-tech ventures, and biotechnology and medical technology firms, where organizations likewise govern experimentation under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项两阶段质性研究（美国国家科学基金会I-CORPS™项目），提出了一个IMPO模型，揭示了团队如何通过学习治理（learning governance）将重复性实验转化为持久的适应性能力，特别是三重循环学习（triple-loop learning）在形成动态能力中的关键作用。
AI.research_question: 重复实验如何从一系列孤立测试转变为持久的适应性能力？团队如何在不确定性条件下治理学习（而非仅仅执行学习）以搜索可行的产品和商业模式？
AI.motivation: 尽管组织越来越依赖实验来应对不确定性，但学术界对重复实验如何演变为持久的适应性能力的机制知之甚少。现有研究缺乏对学习治理（即有意识地修订实验规则）过程的深入理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: IMPO（输入-调节-过程-输出）模型；单环/双环/三环学习理论；动态能力理论；学习治理作为动态能力的微观基础。
AI.method: 两阶段质性研究设计。阶段1：在高度结构化的实验环境（美国NSF I-CORPS™项目）中，采用Gioia方法分析40份半结构化访谈。阶段2：使用访谈、调查、商业模式画布和档案资料三角验证9个完整案例。
AI.findings: （1）创业心智模型和情境调节因素塑造了"实验即搜索"的过程；（2）该过程产生两类产出：学习与行为产出、企业价值；（3）部分团队超越了单环和双环学习，通过重新定义证据阈值、决策权和反思实践，有意识地修订实验规则——这标志着三环学习和适应性能力的形成。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出"学习治理"作为独立构念，并将其定位为动态能力的微观基础；（2）解释了实验如何从一系列孤立测试变为可复合的能力；（3）将模型适用范围扩展到企业创新团队、AI实施团队、深科技创业公司、生物技术和医疗科技公司等情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了如何系统性地治理实验过程以建立持续竞争优势的框架，特别是通过设置证据阈值、明确决策权和建立反思实践来培育三环学习能力。

title: From Connector to Issuer: Positioning Hong Kong as a Green Sukuk Platform under the First Five-year Plan (2026-2030)

detail.title: From Connector to Issuer: Positioning Hong Kong as a Green Sukuk Platform under the First Five-year Plan (2026-2030)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research does not require any ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Hong Kong built a complete legal and tax framework for sukuk more than a decade ago, and its
government issued three US dollar sukuk between 2014 and 2017. Yet no Hong Kong-listed
enterprise has issued a sukuk from Hong Kong, and the market has stayed dormant. This paper
argues that conditions have now changed in a way that earlier studies could not anticipate.
Global sukuk issuance reached a record US$264.8 billion in 2025, and outstanding ESG sukuk are
expected to exceed US$70 billion by the end of 2026. Hong Kong has meanwhile assembled a
green finance infrastructure that no Islamic finance centre matches: a sustainable finance
taxonomy extended to transition activities in January 2026, subsidy schemes for green and digital
bond issuance, and three sovereign tokenised green bonds, the latest a record HK$10 billion issue.
The paper examines Hong Kong's green sukuk opportunity through the lens of the First Five-Year
Plan for Economic and Social Development (2026–2030), whose consultation document promotes
green finance and Middle East engagement but does not mention Islamic finance. It identifies three
differentiators for Hong Kong: a common law system suited to the true-sale requirement of the
forthcoming AAOIFI Shariah Standard No. 62, proven tokenisation infrastructure, and the
offshore renminbi market. It then sets out a practical issuance playbook for Hong Kong-listed
enterprises and assesses the implications for the Hong Kong banking industry.
The paper argues that the convergence of regulatory reform, digital bond infrastructure, growing
Gulf connectivity and the First Five-Year Plan creates a policy window that did not previously
exist. It concludes with policy recommendations framed as a contribution to the Five-Year Plan
consultation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨香港为何在拥有完善伊斯兰债券法律框架十余年后仍未形成伊斯兰债券市场，并论证当前全球ESG伊斯兰债券激增、香港绿色金融基建成熟及"十五五"规划窗口期已创造历史性机遇。文章提出香港三大差异化优势（普通法体系契合AAOIFI第62号准则、代币化基建、离岸人民币市场），并为企业发行与银行业影响提供实践指南。
AI.research_question: 在拥有完善伊斯兰债券法律与税务框架十余年后，香港为何未能激活伊斯兰债券市场？当前哪些条件变化使得香港绿色伊斯兰债券迎来机遇？
AI.motivation: 尽管香港早在十多年前就建立了完整的伊斯兰债券法律与税务框架，且政府于2014-2017年间发行了三笔美元伊斯兰债券，但香港上市企业从未在香港发行伊斯兰债券，市场持续沉寂。作者认为此前研究未能预见的条件变化已创造政策窗口期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策窗口理论（政策窗口）、制度经济学（法律框架适配性）、绿色金融与伊斯兰金融交叉理论、代币化金融基础设施理论
AI.method: 政策分析与制度比较研究，结合全球伊斯兰债券市场数据、香港绿色金融基建现状分析、"十五五"规划文本分析，以及伊斯兰金融标准（AAOIFI第62号准则）的法律适配性研究。
AI.findings: 1）全球伊斯兰债券发行2025年创纪录达2648亿美元，ESG伊斯兰债券预计2026年底超700亿美元；2）香港已建成无伊斯兰金融中心可比的绿色金融基建（转型活动分类、绿色债券补贴、三笔主权代币化绿色债券）；3）香港三大差异化优势：普通法体系适合AAOIFI第62号准则的真实出售要求、成熟的代币化基础设施、离岸人民币市场；4）"十五五"规划咨询文件推动绿色金融和中东合作但未提及伊斯兰金融，存在政策建言空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政策窗口理论应用于伊斯兰金融与绿色金融的交叉领域，提出绿色伊斯兰债券作为新兴市场机会的分析框架；揭示普通法体系与伊斯兰金融标准（AAOFI第62号准则）之间的制度适配机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为香港上市企业提供绿色伊斯兰债券发行的具体操作指南（发行剧本）；为香港银行业评估绿色伊斯兰债券业务影响；为"十五五"规划咨商提供政策建议。

title: The Cascade: Bidirectional Readiness Architecture and the Long-Tail Engagement Thesis
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Cascade: Bidirectional Readiness Architecture and the Long-Tail Engagement Thesis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Joanne Flinn is Founder and Chair of the ESG Institute (Singapore), a Certified B Corporation that develops the ClearSight Intelligence and Greensight platforms referenced in this paper; these instruments and their underlying calibrations are available under commercial licence. The paper's findings are published in full; the proprietary calibrations are not. Julie Schiller, Founder/CEO, ClimateUX is co-author. The authors declare no other financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or personal data. It analyses publicly listed entities and published sources, and ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external or grant funding. It was conducted and funded internally by the ESG Institute (Singapore).

detail.abstract:
Transition risk descends through a system, from capital, through portfolios, supply chains and markets, to the entities and communities at the end of the chain. It transmits as concentrated force from a few large nodes. This paper argues that the same architecture carries readiness in the opposite direction, and that the long tail of at-risk entities, the bulk of any value chain, is not peripheral to that reversal but its load-bearing structure. The proposition that value concentrates in a long tail of smaller actors rather than a short head of large ones has an established lineage: Anderson (2006) showed how falling distribution and coordination costs shift aggregate value toward many low-volume nodes. The readiness argument applies the same economics to transition capacity: as the cost of reaching and enabling small suppliers falls, the readiness of the tail becomes material and addressable. The thesis here is narrower and testable, specifying where in the tail readiness begins and what moves it. The architecture is shared in both directions but the mechanism is not: risk descends as concentrated force, while readiness ascends only by aggregation. From this the central position follows: the systemic risk institutions treat as diversifiable in fact resides in the long tail, so engaging it is not corporate charity but the management of an institution's own exposure. 

The paper's methodological contribution is four design principles for engaging the most constrained participant, their strength resting on convergence from two independent vantages, both grounded in practice. They emerge from the author's transformation work across many companies and fifty-two countries, and independently from years inside Google's Next Billion Users group, distilled by a practitioner co-author; they are corroborated by anti-deficit scholarship, which frames constrained populations by their capabilities, not their lacks. Applied through existing conduits, under trusted partners, with participant value visible and the architecture built to adapt, the principles reverse the cascade. What separates a just reversal from extraction is ownership of the value: the readiness, and the co-benefit dividend it earns, accrue at the long tail first, while the institutions above gain through the reduction of their own systemic exposure. WP-01 and WP-05 measure the exposure; this paper describes the architecture by which it is reversed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，转型风险从资本端通过供应链向下传导至长尾末端实体，而"准备度"（readiness）则沿相反方向自下而上聚合。核心命题是：长尾中小参与者不是边缘角色，而是风险缓解的结构性承载者。论文基于实践和谷歌Next Billion Users组的经验，提炼出四项设计原则，用于激活最受约束的参与者，从而逆转风险 cascade，实现系统性风险的真正管理。
AI.research_question: 在转型风险自上而下传导的系统中，"准备度"如何自下而上聚合？长尾末端的最小参与者在其中扮演什么结构性角色？如何通过设计原则逆转风险传导方向？
AI.motivation: 现有系统性风险框架将长尾参与者视为可分散的、非核心的风险因素，但本文论证其恰恰是风险的真正承载来源。不激活长尾准备度，机构自身的系统性暴露无法根本缓解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 长尾理论（Anderson 2006）：当分布与协调成本下降时，价值向大量低量级节点转移。反赤字学术视角：以能力而非欠缺来定义受约束人群。转型风险传导与准备度聚合的对称架构理论。
AI.method: 两路独立实践来源的收敛：（1）作者在52个国家多家公司的转型变革工作；（2）谷歌Next Billion Users小组多年的实践洞察，由从业者合著者提炼。由反赤字学术视角验证。
AI.findings: 转型风险以集中力形式通过少数大节点向下传导；准备度则只能通过聚合自下而上上升。长尾是风险的实际承载结构。四项设计原则（通过现有渠道、依托可信伙伴、参与者价值可见、架构可适应）可逆转这一级联。
AI.theory_contributions: 将长尾理论从价值分配拓展到转型能力（准备度）的聚合；提出风险传导与准备度聚合共享架构但机制不同（集中力 vs. 聚合）的理论框架；定义了"公正逆转"与"提取"的区分标准——价值的所有权归属。
AI.practical_contributions: 四项可操作的设计原则，用于激活价值链中最受约束的参与者；将长尾参与从企业慈善重新定义为机构自身风险管理；提供了WP-01和WP-05之外描述逆转架构的补充工具。

title: Demystifying Mechanical Intelligence: "Autolligence" (A.L.) and the Illusion of Artificial Intelligence (A.I.) in Contemporary Education
affiliations: University of Crete and

detail.title: Demystifying Mechanical Intelligence: "Autolligence" (A.L.) and the Illusion of Artificial Intelligence (A.I.) in Contemporary Education
detail.abstract: The text critically examines contemporary Artificial Intelligence as a historical and ideological continuation of the industrial organisation of education, psychometrics, and techno-administrative control. Its central argument is that current algorithmic systems do not possess genuine intelligence, intention, or consciousness, but rather operate as mechanisms of statistical recombination of data; for this reason, the term Autolligence is proposed as a more accurate designation. Using a historico-hermeneutic approach, the paper traces the genealogy of these mechanisms from the factory-school model and teaching machines to learning and assessment systems based on standardisation, quantification, and algorithmic classification. It further argues that the integration of AI into education tends to reduce pedagogical autonomy, intensify surveillance, homogenise creativity, and reproduce inequalities. As an alternative, the paper advances a critical, biocentric pedagogical perspective, termed critical enbiagogy, which seeks to reconnect learning with living, communal, and non-anthropocentric forms of knowledge and practise.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地审视当代人工智能作为工业化教育、心理测量学和技术行政控制的历史与意识形态延续。提出“Autolligence”一词替代“人工智能”，认为算法系统只是数据的统计重组机制，缺乏真正的智能、意图或意识。采用历史阐释学方法追溯从工厂学校模型、教学机器到基于标准化、量化和算法分类的学习评估系统的谱系。指出AI融入教育会削弱教学自主性、强化监控、同质化创造力并加剧不平等。最后提出“批判性共生教育学”（critical enbiagogy）作为替代方案，旨在将学习与生命、共同体及非人类中心的知识与实践重新联结。
AI.research_question: 当代人工智能在教育领域的应用是否是工业化教育、心理测量学和技术行政控制的历史延续？它如何影响教育自主性、创造力与平等？
AI.motivation: 揭示AI“智能”本质的虚假性，批判其以技术中立名义掩盖的标准化、控制与不平等的教育逻辑，并提出替代性教育范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史阐释学（historico-hermeneutic approach）；谱系学方法；批判教育学；生物中心主义（biocentric）教育哲学。
AI.method: 历史阐释学方法：通过谱系学追溯，从工厂学校模型、教学机器到当代算法分类系统的历史演变。
AI.findings: 1. 当代AI是工业教育模式和技术行政控制的延续；2. AI系统缺乏真正智能，本质是统计重组，应称为“Autolligence”；3. AI融入教育会削弱教育自主性、强化监控、同质化创造力、加剧不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出“Autolligence”概念以重新定义算法系统的本质；提出“批判性共生教育学”（critical enbiagogy）作为非人类中心、与生命和共同体联结的替代教育范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示AI在教育中的标准化与监控风险；为教育实践者提供批判性审视AI的视角；提出以生态和共同体为导向的教育实践方向。

title: Trading on Information versus Trading on Control in Event-contingent Markets

detail.title: Trading on Information versus Trading on Control in Event-contingent Markets
detail.abstract: Event-contingent markets trade claims on outcomes (court rulings, mergers, elections, platform-resolved events) that some traders can move, not merely forecast. This paper develops an equilibrium theory of this moral hazard, in which exposure precedes action and trades change the world. With rational dealers, an invariance theorem holds: trading intensity, informativeness, and calibration are unaffected by causal power, which is priced as an identified premium while hedgers finance unbounded real distortion. Manipulation pays only under mechanical liquidity or hidden power. Causal power is derived from governance, organized by a causal Gram matrix, and regulated best by severing feedback, not policing information.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了事件依赖型市场中的道德风险问题，即交易者不仅能预测结果，还能直接影响结果。研究发现了一个不变性定理：因果力量不影响交易强度、信息含量和校准度，但会被定价为溢价，同时对冲者会为无限的真实扭曲提供资金。操纵只有在机械流动性或隐藏力量下才有利可图。
AI.research_question: 在事件依赖型市场中，交易者能够通过交易影响事件结果（道德风险）时，市场均衡的特征是什么？因果力量如何被定价和监管？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常假设交易者只能预测或对冲事件结果，但在许多现实市场中（如法庭裁决、并购、选举等），交易者的行为本身可能影响结果。这一道德风险问题尚未得到系统的理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于理性交易商模型、因果格兰矩阵（causal Gram matrix）、不变性定理等理论工具，构建了包含道德风险的事件市场均衡理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析，推导出不变性定理，分析因果力量的定价机制以及操纵行为的条件。
AI.findings: (1) 不变性定理：因果力量不影响交易强度、信息含量和校准度；(2) 因果力量被定价为已识别的溢价；(3) 对冲者会为无限的真实扭曲提供资金；(4) 操纵只在机械流动性或隐藏力量下才有利润；(5) 最佳监管方式是切断反馈而非监控信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统建立了事件市场中道德风险的均衡理论，揭示了因果力量的定价机制，提出了不变性定理，扩展了对市场效率与操纵行为的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为事件市场的设计和监管提供了重要指导，特别是关于因果力量的定价和反馈机制切断的监管策略，有助于防止市场操纵和真实扭曲。

title: When Peak Usage Becomes Capacity: Optimal Charging of Battery Swapping Stations Under Demand Charges
affiliations: , The University of Hong Kong (HKU) - Faculty of Business and Economics, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Zhejiang University - School of Management

detail.title: When Peak Usage Becomes Capacity: Optimal Charging of Battery Swapping Stations Under Demand Charges
detail.abstract: Battery swapping stations provide a promising alternative for rapid electric vehicle (EV) refueling, but their charging operations must coordinate stochastic demand, renewable energy availability, battery degradation, and demand charge tariffs. We formulate the charging problem of a renewable-integrated station as a finite-horizon dynamic program and uncover a fundamental cost-capacity tradeoff: while peak grid usage level incurs demand charges, it also creates reusable charging capacity that can benefit future operations. We analytically characterize the optimal single-period charging policy and establish a two-threshold structure that separates aggressive, economic, and conservative charging regimes. This structural result provides a mathematical explanation for why optimal charging decisions can be non-monotone in the peak usage level and even exceed a no-demand-charge benchmark. To address the curse of dimensionality in multi-period settings, we leverage these structural insights to develop structure-informed heuristics and a structure-guided reinforcement learning policy. Using a case study of a NIO battery swapping station in the Netherlands, we quantify the financial impact of ignoring demand charges and demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed policies in improving operational performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了可再生能源集成电池换电站的充电问题，揭示了峰值用电与充电容量之间的基本成本-容量权衡，并基于动态规划方法提出了具有两阈值结构的最优充电策略，最后通过荷兰NIO换电站案例验证了策略的有效性。
AI.research_question: 可再生能源集成电池换电站如何在考虑随机需求、可再生能源波动、电池退化和需求电费的情况下，制定最优充电策略？
AI.motivation: 电池换电站是电动汽车快速补能的重要方案，但其充电运营面临随机需求、可再生能源不确定性、电池退化及需求电费等多重挑战，现有研究缺乏对需求电费这一关键成本因素的深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限时域动态规划；两阈值最优充电策略理论（激进、经济、保守三种充电机制）；成本-容量权衡理论。
AI.method: 通过有限时域动态规划建模，解析推导单期最优充电策略的两阈值结构；基于结构洞察设计结构化启发式算法和结构引导的强化学习策略；采用荷兰NIO换电站的实际数据进行案例研究。
AI.findings: （1）发现了峰值用电水平与可复用充电容量之间的基本权衡；（2）最优充电决策具有两阈值结构，将充电行为分为激进、经济和保守三种机制；（3）最优充电决策在峰值用电水平上可能呈现非单调性，甚至可能超过无需求电费基准；（4）所提出的结构化策略在实际案例中显著优于忽视需求电费的基准策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从理论上揭示了需求电费下充电问题中的成本-容量权衡，并建立了具有两阈值结构的最优充电策略解析框架，解释了最优充电决策的非单调性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电池换电站运营商提供了可落地的结构化充电策略，在应对需求电费的同时提升运营效率；案例研究量化了忽视需求电费的经济损失，验证了策略的实际应用价值。

title: Algorithmic Due Diligence in Critical Resource Value Chains

detail.title: Algorithmic Due Diligence in Critical Resource Value Chains

publicationDetails.detailsText: A shorter version is under review at a top international law journal.

detail.abstract: This Article argues that the critical minerals transition is increasingly governed through an "ESG truth-machine": traceability platforms, certification, vendor risk-scoring, automated audit triage, and, increasingly, generative systems that produce sustainability narratives from partial and asymmetric data. EU and transnational regimes present these techniques as technocratic solutions to supply-chain opacity. International legal scholarship, however, has been slower to treat AI-enabled compliance infrastructures as part of what due diligence is, rather than as implementation detail. The result is a structural mismatch between the normative aims of due diligence (prevention, mitigation, remedy) and the mechanisms firms use to demonstrate compliance (datafication, scoring, and disclosure optimization). Drawing on the growing empirical literature on due diligence implementation and on the EU's converging due diligence, reporting, batteries, critical raw materials, and AI instruments, the Article advances three doctrinal claims. First, disclosure regimes can manufacture credibility while hollowing out responsibility, enabling algorithmic greenwashing unless law disciplines the methods that produce ESG claims (provenance, assumptions, and contestability), not only their outputs. Second, compliance technologies can themselves generate adverse impacts, so dignity and equality constraints must attach to the tools that perform due diligence. Third, sustainability that ignores fiscal contribution risks legitimacy without redistribution: in extractives, tax practices shape state capacity, and state capacity is a precondition for environmental and labor governance. The Article also addresses the interstate dimension of these regimes, which producer states have contested as instruments of country-level exclusion, and closes with an architectural agenda for "algorithmic due diligence" centered on an ESG evidence chain, rightsrespecting technology governance, and fiscal coherence.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了关键矿产转型正通过"ESG真相机器"（可追溯性平台、认证、供应商风险评分、自动化审计及生成式AI系统）被治理。国际法学术未能将AI驱动的合规基础设施视为尽责管理的组成部分，导致尽责管理的规范目标与企业的合规展示机制之间存在结构性错配。文章提出三项主张：披露制度可能制造可信度而掏空责任；合规技术本身可能产生不利影响；忽视财政贡献的可持续性存在合法性风险。最后提出以ESG证据链、尊重权利的技术治理和财政一致性为核心的"算法化尽责管理"架构。
AI.research_question: 国际法如何应对AI驱动的尽责管理基础设施与可持续性治理之间的结构性错配？
AI.motivation: 国际法学界将AI赋能合规基础设施视为实施细节而非尽责管理的组成部分，导致理论滞后于实践，产生治理盲区。
AI.theoretical_framework: ESG真相机器、算法化尽责管理、数据化治理、财政一致性理论
AI.method: 基于尽责管理实施的实证文献，结合欧盟尽责管理、报告、电池、关键原材料及AI等多重监管工具的交叉分析，提出三项教义性主张。
AI.findings: 披露制度可能制造可信度而掏空责任（算法漂绿）；合规技术本身可产生不利影响；忽视财政贡献的可持续性存在合法性缺失；产国国将现行机制视为国家层面的排斥工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI合规基础设施从"实施细节"提升为国际法尽责管理的核心构成；提出"算法化尽责管理"概念框架；揭示数据化治理与实质性尽责管理之间的结构性张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及跨国监管者提供ESG证据链、尊重权利的技术治理和财政一致性三方面的制度设计建议；揭示算法漂绿的识别与规制路径。

title: The Nature of Conveyance under Section 11 of MOFA - Is it a Paper Conveyance - Is it a Paper Conveyance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Nature of Conveyance under Section 11 of MOFA - Is it a Paper Conveyance - Is it a Paper Conveyance
detail.abstract: This article examines the jurisprudence of the Bombay High Court on the unilateral deemed conveyance introduced into the Maharashtra Ownership Flats Act, 1963 by the amendment of 2008, and in particular the now-settled practice by which the Court, declining to interfere with the summary orders of the Competent Authority, relegates contested questions of title, area and entitlement to a civil suit. It asks whether that practice, endorsed by the Supreme Court in Arunkumar H. Shah HUF v. Avon Arcade Premises Cooperative Society Ltd., vindicates or defeats the beneficial purpose of the legislation. Proceeding doctrinally through the primary authorities, from Mazda Construction Company v. Sultanabad Darshan CHS Ltd. through the decision of Mohta, J., the ownership-versus-lease line culminating in Haresh Vijaysinh Bhatia, and the most recent pronouncements applying the Maharashtra Ownership Flats (Amendment and Validation) Act, 2025, the article advances a single thesis. The relegation doctrine is doctrinally correct but substantively incomplete: because the deemed conveyance transfers only the promoter's actual right, title and interest and binds no civil court, the statute delivers to the successful society a registrable title rather than a secure one. The article contends that the counter-line of interference is not a rival doctrine but the same principle policing the outer edge of a summary jurisdiction, that the distinction between questions of title and questions of the scope of the promoter's obligation is unstable in application, and that the 2025 Validation Act's bar on suits collides with the very civil-suit guarantee on which the entire edifice of deference rests.

AI.tldr: 本文分析孟买高等法院在2008年《马哈拉施特拉邦公寓所有权法》修正案引入的单方推定过户问题，指出法院回避干预简易命令、将产权争议交由民事诉讼的做法（“移送原则”）在教义上正确但实质不完整：推定过户仅转移开发商实际权利，不约束民事法院，导致业主获得可登记但非安全的产权。文章进一步指出2025年《验证法》禁止诉讼的规定与整个制度依赖的民事诉讼保障相冲突。
AI.research_question: 孟买高等法院在单方推定过户案件中形成的“移送原则”——即拒绝干预主管机关的简易命令、将有争议的产权、面积及 entitlement问题交由民事诉讼处理——是否实现或背离了《马哈拉施特拉邦公寓所有权法》的受益性立法目的？
AI.motivation: 《马哈拉施特拉邦公寓所有权法》2008年修正案引入了单方推定过户制度，旨在保护公寓业主权益，但孟买高等法院在实践中形成了将产权争议移送民事诉讼的做法。最高法院在Arunkumar H. Shah案中认可了这一做法。然而2025年《验证法》又禁止了此类诉讼，引发该制度逻辑自洽性与实际效果的严重疑问，亟需教义澄清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 立法目的解释、司法谦抑与简易管辖权边界理论、产权转移的登记效力与实质安全性区分。
AI.method: doctrinal analysis（教义分析），梳理从Mazda Construction案到Mohta法官判决、Haresh Vijaysinh Bhatia案以及2025年《验证法》后的最新判例。
AI.findings: 1. “移送原则”在教义上正确——法院不干预简易管辖权范围内的主管机关命令是适当的；2. 但该原则实质不完整——推定过户只转移开发商实际拥有的权利、利益和产权，不约束民事法院，业主获得的是可登记但非安全的产权（registrable title rather than secure one）；3. 所谓的“反移送路线”并非对立教义，而是同一原则在简易管辖权外沿的边界界定；4. 产权问题与开发商义务范围问题的区分在实践中不稳定；5. 2025年《验证法》禁止诉讼的规定直接与“移送原则”所依赖的民事诉讼保障前提相冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了“移送原则”教义正确性与实质不完整性之间的张力，区分了“可登记的产权”与“安全的产权”两个概念；2. 指出产权争议与义务范围争议区分的实践不稳定性，挑战了既有判例法的可操作性；3. 揭示了2025年《验证法》与既有司法实践之间的根本逻辑矛盾。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为印度房地产法中业主权益保护提供了重要的法律解释指引；2. 提醒立法者与司法者注意推定过户制度中“纸面安全”与“实质安全”的差距；3. 对2025年《验证法》的合宪性与逻辑自洽性提出质疑，可能影响未来立法修正方向。

title: AI Computing Demand and Energy Market Co-movement: Evidence from EGARCH-X and DCC-GARCH Models

detail.title: AI Computing Demand and Energy Market Co-movement: Evidence from EGARCH-X and DCC-GARCH Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether the expansion of AI-related computing demand has created a new financial linkage between major technology equities and energy infrastructure assets. Using 817 daily observations from March 2023 to July 2026, we estimate an EGARCH(1,1)-X model augmented with the MOVE Index as an exogenous variance regressor (Stage 1), and a bivariate DCC-GARCH model (Engle, 2002) on GARCH-filtered standardized residuals (Stage 2) for seven asset pairs spanning AI equities (NVDA, MSFT, SOXX) and energy infrastructure (URA, XLU). The MOVE Index coefficient δ is statistically significant for NVDA (δ = 0.023, p < 0.01), SOXX (δ = 0.030, p < 0.001), and XLU (δ = 0.018, p < 0.001), confirming macro-financial stress transmission to AI-equity volatility. DCC-GARCH estimates reveal a significant increase in NVDA-URA co-movement (Δρ = +0.175, p < 0.001) and SOXX-URA co-movement (Δρ = +0.108, p < 0.01) following July 2024, while the control pair URA-XLU shows no structural break (Andrews sup-Wald p = 0.597). These findings suggest an AI-specific, rather than broadmarket, origin for the documented co-movement increase. Policy implications for energy infrastructure investment and systemic risk monitoring are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本研究以2023年3月至2026年7月的日度数据，运用EGARCH(1,1)-X模型和DCC-GARCH模型，发现AI算力需求扩张使AI科技股（NVDA、SOXX）与铀矿/能源基础设施资产（URA）之间的波动溢出和动态相关性显著增强，且该联动具有AI特异性而非广泛市场驱动特征。
AI.research_question: AI相关计算需求的扩张是否在主要科技股与能源基础设施资产之间创造了新的金融联动关系？
AI.motivation: 随着AI算力需求爆发式增长，科技企业与能源基础设施之间的实体经济联系日益紧密（如数据中心耗电），但这一联系是否已转化为金融市场层面的联动尚不明确。识别这种新的金融联动对投资组合管理、系统性风险监测和能源基础设施投资政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观金融压力传导理论（MOVE指数作为外生波动率变量）；DCC-GARCH动态条件相关模型（Engle, 2002）；结构断点检验（Andrews sup-Wald检验）。
AI.method: 两阶段实证设计：（1）EGARCH(1,1)-X模型，以MOVE指数（债券市场波动率指数）作为外生方差回归量，估计宏观金融压力对资产波动率的传导效应；（2）对GARCH滤波后的标准化残差估计双变量DCC-GARCH模型，检验动态条件相关系数的结构性变化（以2024年7月为潜在断点）。
AI.findings: （1）MOVE指数系数δ对NVDA（δ=0.023, p<0.01）、SOXX（δ=0.030, p<0.001）和XLU（δ=0.018, p<0.001）显著，证实宏观金融压力会传导至AI股票波动率；（2）2024年7月后，NVDA-URA相关系数显著增加0.175（p<0.001），SOXX-URA相关系数增加0.108（p<0.01）；（3）控制组URA-XLU无显著结构断点（p=0.597），说明联动增加源于AI特异性而非广泛市场因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从金融市场联动视角实证揭示了AI算力扩张作为新型金融连接渠道的存在性，将AI-能源实体关联拓展至金融层面，丰富和补充了"技术-能源"交叉领域的金融传染与波动溢出理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源基础设施投资政策提供风险预警依据，建议监管机构关注AI数据中心扩张对能源资产的价格稳定影响；为投资组合管理提供AI-能源跨资产配置的时变相关性特征，助力风险管理与对冲策略优化。

reference: 73 UCLA Law Review (forthcoming 2026); Protect Borrowers Research Paper Forthcoming
title: Consumer Law Meets the New Company Store
affiliations: Temple University Beasley School of Law and

detail.title: Consumer Law Meets the New Company Store
detail.abstract:
Firms have discovered new ways to extract value from workers beyond traditional labor exploitation.  In labor markets increasingly characterized by monopsony power, platform work, and financialization, employers push a variety of financial products onto workers and establish surveillance systems that monetize worker data.  This Article introduces the Triple Extraction Model to explain how firms profit from workers through the three interconnected channels of labor productivity, financial products, and data commodification.  In turn, firms are turning the workplace into a modern company store.

Building on prior work establishing workers as “worker-consumers,” this Article proposes that workers facing the Triple Extraction Model turn to consumer law to complement traditional employment and labor law protections.  While treating workers as consumers faces typological and theoretical tensions, the worker-consumer framework offers legal tools that practitioners have already begun utilizing to rein in exploitation.  For instance, the Dodd-Frank Act’s prohibition of “abusive” practices, the Fair Credit Reporting Act’s (FCRA) requirements for treatment of personal data, and federal and state unfair and deceptive acts and practices (UDAP) laws offer mechanisms to challenge workplace financial practices.  In addition, even during a time of federal inaction, a little-known provision of the Dodd-Frank Act allows states to enforce the entire body of federal consumer financial protection law.

Consumer law works best for workers when it supports collective action.  The application of consumer law to the workplace can reduce surveillance that chills organizing and establish minimum standards that free up union bargaining capital for wages and other benefits.

As firms become more creative in monetizing their captive workforces, sustainable change requires both sophisticated legal strategies and shifts in workplace power dynamics.  This Article provides the theoretical understanding and doctrinal tools necessary to challenge the new company store, demonstrating how consumer law can complement employment and labor laws and ultimately encourage self-enforcement through unions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"三重榨取模型"，揭示企业通过劳动生产力、金融产品和数据商品化三个渠道从工人身上获利，并论证消费者法律可作为传统劳动法的补充工具，通过集体行动机制应对新型职场剥削。
AI.research_question: 在现代劳动市场（买方垄断、平台经济、金融化）背景下，企业如何通过新的方式从工人身上榨取价值？消费者法律能否以及如何作为传统劳动法的补充工具，应对这一新型剥削模式？
AI.motivation: 企业正通过金融产品推销、数据监控等新型手段从工人身上获利，而传统劳动法框架难以有效应对这些超越"劳动剥削"范畴的行为，亟需新的理论视角和法律工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三重榨取模型（Triple Extraction Model）：劳动生产力、金融产品、数据商品化三个相互关联的渠道；工人-消费者（worker-consumer）框架。
AI.method: 法律理论分析，结合现有法律框架（《多德-弗兰克法案》《公平信用报告法》、UDAP法律）的适用性论证，以及实践案例的整合分析。
AI.findings: 消费者法律可为工人提供传统劳动法之外的补充保护；集体行动是消费者法律发挥效用的关键机制；消费者法律可减少抑制工会组织的监控，建立最低标准，释放工会谈判资本；州级执法机制（多德-弗兰克法案条款）可在联邦不作为时发挥作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"三重榨取模型"作为分析当代企业剥削工人的新理论框架；深化"工人-消费者"概念，为跨法律领域（劳动法与消费者法）的理论整合提供基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供具体法律工具（反滥用条款、数据保护要求、反不正当竞争法）以应对职场金融剥削；揭示州级执法的战略可能性；提出通过消费者法律支持工会集体行动的实务路径。

title: Future Research Directions: Overcoming Key Bottlenecks in the Energy Transition – The Grid
affiliations: University of Exeter

detail.title: Future Research Directions: Overcoming Key Bottlenecks in the Energy Transition – The Grid

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The POLICY CLUB

detail.abstract:
The electricity grid has become the principal bottleneck to the energy transition. While renewable energy technologies continue to advance rapidly, today's electricity infrastructure was largely designed for centralised fossil-fuel generation and is struggling to accommodate distributed renewable energy, electrification, artificial intelligence and rapidly growing data-centre demand.

The next phase of the energy transition therefore depends not only on engineering innovation but also on the commercialisation of decentralised electricity systems. Microgrids, supported by micro-markets, offer a complementary pathway that can co-evolve alongside the modernisation of the conventional grid.

Building on recent policy developments, including the UK's Clean Power 2030 Action Plan, together with observations from industry, this article identifies the principal barriers preventing decentralised electricity systems from scaling and proposes a research agenda focused on governance, financing mechanisms and business models. Mobilising institutional capital towards decentralised electricity systems may become one of the defining challenges—and opportunities—of the next phase of the energy transition.

AI.tldr: 本文指出电网已成为能源转型的主要瓶颈，提出微电网与微市场作为补充路径，并识别了去中心化电力系统规模化面临的主要障碍，呼吁从治理、融资机制和商业模式三方面开展研究。
AI.research_question: 去中心化电力系统在规模化过程中面临哪些主要障碍？如何通过治理、融资机制和商业模式推动其发展？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源技术持续进步，但现有电网基础设施仍以集中式化石燃料发电为设计基础，难以适应分布式可再生能源、电气化、人工智能及数据中心需求的快速增长，电网已成为能源转型的核心瓶颈。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源转型理论、去中心化电力系统、微电网与微市场、制度经济学（治理机制）、资本配置理论。
AI.method: 基于政策分析（如英国《清洁电力2030行动计划》）与行业观察，提出研究议程。
AI.findings: 识别出三大主要障碍：治理机制不足、融资机制缺失、商业模式不成熟。机构资本向去中心化电力系统流动是下一阶段的关键挑战与机遇。
AI.theory_contributions: 将能源转型讨论从技术层面拓展至制度与商业层面，提出微电网与微市场作为集中式电网现代化的互补演化路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和行业从业者提供了去中心化电力系统规模化发展的研究方向和行动框架，特别是关于治理、融资和商业模式的具体议程。

title: Monitoring with Multiple Parameters at the Boundary: The Chi-Bar-Squared Process

detail.title: Monitoring with Multiple Parameters at the Boundary: The Chi-Bar-Squared Process

declarations.funderStatement: There are no funding interests to disclose.

detail.abstract: When an inequality-restricted hypothesis is re-tested over an expanding sample, the monitored likelihood-ratio path converges to what we call the chi-bar-squared process: the squared norm of the projection of a multi-clock Gaussian process onto a convex cone whose geometry, measured in the evolving information metric, drifts with the sample fraction-so the classical chi-bar-squared mixture weights become deterministic weight paths. We establish this limit theory and prove three structural results that make it usable: an exact factorization with purely triangular cross-dependence for trend-level pairs; closed-form weight drift for non-orthogonal pairs; and full process independence of the trend and wrong-skew monitors at the singular boundary of the normal-half-normal frontier model, licensing a guarded joint procedure with exact size apportionment. A local power theory completes the analysis: a noncentral process whose signal accumulates like the square root of each coordinate's clock, leading-order minimaxity of the constant standardized boundary over all monitoringboundary shapes, guard costs bounded by size shares, local asymptotic normality in λ 3 at the singular boundary, and cluster robustness through a cubed Moulton factor.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在扩增样本上重新检验不等式约束假设时的监控似然比路径收敛问题，提出了"卡方-bar平方过程"这一新概念，并建立了相应的极限理论、结构分解结果和局部功效理论。
AI.research_question: 当不等式约束假设在扩增样本上被重新检验时，监控似然比路径的极限分布是什么？其结构性质和功效表现如何？
AI.motivation: 传统卡方-bar平方分布仅适用于固定样本，无法刻画监控过程中信息度规随时间漂移带来的动态效应，需要建立新的极限理论来刻画这一过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卡方-bar平方过程、凸锥投影、多时钟高斯过程、信息度规、局部渐近正态性
AI.method: 建立监控似然比路径的极限分布理论，证明三项结构分解结果（精确因子化、非正交对权重漂移封闭形式、趋势与错误偏度监控的独立性），并推导局部功效理论（非中心过程、最小最大最优性、防护成本边界、聚类稳健性）。
AI.findings: (1) 监控似然比路径收敛到卡方-bar平方过程；(2) 趋势水平对之间存在纯三角交叉依赖的精确因子化分解；(3) 非正交对存在权重漂移的封闭形式；(4) 在法线-半法线边界模型中趋势与错误偏度监控过程完全独立；(5) 信号累积与各坐标时钟平方根成正比；(6) 常数标准化边界在所有监控边界形状中达到最小最大最优性；(7) 防护成本受限于规模份额；(8) 在奇异边界处存在λ³阶局部渐近正态性；(9) 聚类稳健性通过立方的Moulton因子实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 开创性地提出了卡方-bar平方过程，将经典的卡方-bar平方混合权重扩展为确定性权重路径，并为动态假设检验提供了完整的极限理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际应用中的时序监控提供了可操作的边界形状选择指南（常数标准化边界的最优性）、防护成本控制方法以及聚类数据的稳健推断工具。

title: Import tariff transmission in a production network
affiliations: Deutsche Bundesbank,  and Deutsche Bundesbank

detail.title: Import tariff transmission in a production network
detail.abstract: We find that whether US import tariffs have supply-side effects or demand-side effects on US manufacturing sectors depends on where the affected sectors are located in the US production network. Using local projections in a panel of US manufacturing sectors, we find that US import tariffs —including the 2018-19 tariff hikes— led to sectoral output contractions via two different channels: (1) Tariff increases act as negative supply shifters for sectors that use goods from tariff-facing sectors as input in production and thus face rising input costs. (2) Tariff increases act as negative demand shifters for sectors whose customer sectors suffer negative supply side effects due to tariffs and reduce their production. We show that these results are consistent with a stylized production network model featuring complementarities in production. Overall, our finding suggests that tariffs markedly reduce US manufacturing production and that the role of input–output linkages is key for understanding the transmission of import tariff shocks to output and producer prices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国进口关税对制造业的影响取决于受影响的部门在生产网络中的位置。关税通过两种渠道导致产出收缩：一是提高受影响部门的中间投入成本（供给侧效应），二是下游客户部门因遭受关税冲击而减少生产（需求侧效应）。研究发现投入产出关联是理解关税冲击传导的关键。
AI.research_question: 美国进口关税如何通过生产网络的投入产出关联对制造业部门产生供给侧和需求侧效应？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注关税对直接受影响部门的影响，但忽略了关税通过生产网络产生的间接溢出效应。本文旨在揭示关税冲击在上下游部门间的传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于具有生产互补性的风格化生产网络模型，分析关税冲击通过投入产出关联的传导机制。
AI.method: 使用美国制造业部门面板数据，采用局部投影法（local projections）进行实证分析，涵盖2018-2019年关税上调时期。
AI.findings: （1）关税作为负向供给侧冲击，提高使用关税受影响部门产品作为中间投入的部门的投入成本；（2）关税作为负向需求侧冲击，客户部门受关税供给侧影响而减少生产，从而减少对上游部门的需求。两种渠道均导致制造业产出显著下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了关税冲击通过生产网络同时产生供给侧和需求侧两种传导渠道，拓展了贸易政策的宏观经济学分析框架，强调了投入产出关联在理解关税冲击传导中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估关税政策的全面经济影响提供了重要参考，表明关税的负面影响会通过生产网络放大，需关注间接溢出效应。

title: The New Indentured Servitude
affiliations: Temple University Beasley School of Law

detail.title: The New Indentured Servitude
detail.abstract:
Workers across the United States are increasingly bound by employment contracts that courts, policymakers, advocates, and the workers themselves are calling “modern indentured servitude.” These “stay-or-pay” contracts require workers to pay thousands or tens of thousands of dollars if they leave before completing a specified term of employment. They take multiple forms, including Training Repayment Agreement Provisions (TRAPs) that require reimbursement for putative training costs, liquidated damages clauses triggered by early departure, and clauses demanding that the worker pay the employer’s “lost profits.” At least one in thirteen U.S. workers is bound by a stay-or-pay provision, which is frequently woven together with other restrictive covenants to trap a worker in a web of immobility.

The repeated invocation of “indentured servitude” runs through the litigation, regulatory enforcement, and legislative debates surrounding stay-or-pay clauses. The Article thus answers calls to extend Thirteenth Amendment scholarship into the modern labor context by analyzing examples of new stay-or-pay contracts through the free labor tradition. That tradition, though debated in its overall meaning, includes the positive rights to quit and to change employers. A stay-or-pay contract that functionally prevents a worker from quitting and changing jobs violates this free labor principle under the Amendment.

By the mid-nineteenth century, Americans came to view indentured servitude as incompatible with freedom. A similar normative evolution is underway today with stay-or-pay contracts, as there is a broad recognition that the formal right to quit is meaningless when exercising it can lead to financial ruin. Free labor theory combined with the “new indentured servitude” terminology is helping to move courts to deny enforcement of stay-or-pay contracts under trafficking theories, state legislators to ban the contracts ex-ante, and federal agencies to declare the contracts void. Likewise, advocates should consider pursuing Thirteenth Amendment-based challenges to stay-or-pay contracts as a manifestation of constitutional political economy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美国“留任或赔偿”合同（stay-or-pay contracts）如何构成现代契约奴役，并运用第十三修正案的自由劳动传统分析其违法性，指出这种合同实际上剥夺了工人辞职和更换雇主的实质性权利。
AI.research_question: “留任或赔偿”合同是否构成现代契约奴役？第十三修正案的自由劳动传统如何适用于此类合同？
AI.motivation: 美国超过1/13的工人受此类合同约束，其被广泛称为“现代契约奴役”，但缺乏系统的宪法层面分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第十三修正案的自由劳动传统（包括辞职权和更换雇主权）、宪法政治经济学。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、历史比较分析（19世纪契约奴役与现代实践对比）、案例分析与规范论证。
AI.findings: 此类合同从功能上阻止工人辞职和更换工作，违反第十三修正案的自由劳动原则；当前正在发生类似19世纪的规范演进，法院、立法机构和联邦机构正逐步否定其效力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将第十三修正案学术研究拓展至现代劳动契约领域；提出基于宪法的政治经济学挑战路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律从业者提供基于第十三修正案的诉讼策略；支持立法禁止此类合同；推动联邦机构宣布其无效。

title: Faithful Agencies
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School, Harvard Law School and UC Berkeley School of Law

detail.title: Faithful Agencies
detail.abstract:
For nearly a century, Congress’s primary instrument for insulating agencies from presidential control was “independence,” expressed, quintessentially, as for-cause removal protection for agency heads. That era is over. After the Supreme Court’s decision in Trump v. Slaughter, removal restrictions are presumptively unconstitutional, and the remaining hallmarks of agency independence, like staggered terms and partisan balancing requirements, are diminished as a result. Meanwhile, successive presidents have embraced a muscular conception of executive power, which the Trump administration has pressed to the limit.


This Article develops principles of institutional design for an era of presidential unilateralism. Even without removal protections, Congress has many tools at its disposal to help agencies resist an arrogating president. Congress can deploy these tools strategically, bundling and layering them, to hamper a president bent on derailing agencies from their statutory mandates. Canvassing the U.S. Code, we identify scores of statutory design features—many obscure and seldom considered together—that promote agency faithfulness to the enacting Congress’s objectives. We label these devices fidelity structures and organize them into a taxonomy of four categories: financing arrangements, personnel rules, internal architecture, and external linkages. We then map their presence across every executive department and nine major independent agencies, uncovering several striking patterns in their use—with implications for future institutional designers in Congress.


Fidelity structures, we argue, do more than build agency resilience: they vindicate the separation of powers. Because the laws the president must faithfully execute are overwhelmingly the work of past Congresses, the Take Care Clause is by its nature a command to abide by legislative bargains over time. This intertemporal check—yesterday’s legislature constraining today’s executive—is especially important now that party unity has weakened horizontal checks between the political branches.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在总统单边主义时代，国会如何通过"忠诚结构"（fidelity structures）——包括融资安排、人事规则、内部架构和外部联系四类制度设计工具——来确保行政机关忠于法定职责，维护权力分立。
AI.research_question: 在总统单边主义时代，国会如何设计制度工具以确保行政机关忠于国会制定的法定目标？
AI.motivation: 最高法院在Trump v. Slaughter案中推翻了对机构负责人免职的保护，传统"独立性"机制失效；同时历任总统强化行政权力，特朗普政府将其推向极致。在此背景下，需要新的制度设计思路。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权力分立理论、忠实执行条款（Take Care Clause）的跨时域约束逻辑、制度设计理论。
AI.method: 对美国法典进行系统梳理，识别法定设计特征；将"忠诚结构"分为四类（融资、人事、内部架构、外部联系）；映射其在各行政部门和九个主要独立机构的分布模式。
AI.findings: 发现了多种分散、常被忽视的法定设计工具，揭示了其在行政部门和独立机构中使用的显著模式，表明国会可通过战略性捆绑和分层部署这些工具来制约总统。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"忠诚结构"这一新概念和分析框架；揭示了跨时域立法约束（昨天的立法约束今天的行政）作为横向制衡弱化后的重要补充机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国会在总统单边主义时代提供了可操作的具体制度设计工具清单和分类；为未来的制度设计者提供了实证分布模式，辅助立法决策。

title: The Colonial Origins of Institutional Corruption in the Philippines: A Historical Institutional Analysis of How Spanish and American Colonial Systems Created the Structures of Graft That Persist Today

detail.title: The Colonial Origins of Institutional Corruption in the Philippines: A Historical Institutional Analysis of How Spanish and American Colonial Systems Created the Structures of Graft That Persist Today

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Journal on Graft and Corruption, Vol. 11, Issue 2, 2026

detail.abstract: This paper interrogates the persistence of institutional corruption in the Philippines through the lens of historical institutionalism, arguing against longstanding cultural and quasi-biological explanations that attribute graft to an essential national character. It contends instead that corruption is best understood as an institutional legacy: a path-dependent outcome of critical junctures established under Spanish colonial rule (1565–1898) and subsequently reinforced, rather than dismantled, by American colonial administration (1898–1946). Drawing on historical institutionalism, the extractive-institutions framework of Acemoglu and Robinson (2012), and the political marketplace approach to clientelism, the paper traces five interlocking institutional legacies: the transformation of pre-colonial elites into a landed and bureaucratic principalía; the conversion of indigenous reciprocity into a hierarchical padrino system; the consolidation of the hacienda economy and its attendant land inequality; the centralization of political and fiscal authority in "Imperial Manila"; and the enduring political influence of the Catholic Church. Employing comparative historical analysis of colonial administrative records and the secondary historiography of Philippine state formation, the paper demonstrates that American electoral and bureaucratic reforms were superimposed upon, rather than substituted for, pre-existing extractive arrangements, producing a hybrid political order that is democratic in form but oligarchic in substance. The analysis finds that these five legacies remain empirically traceable in contemporary political dynasties, patronage networks, land reform failures, regional fiscal dependency, and religious influence over policy. The paper concludes that anti-corruption reform premised on individual ethics rather than structural transformation is unlikely to succeed, and that policy must instead target the institutional architecture inherited from empire.

AI.tldr: 本文通过历史制度主义视角，批判了将菲律宾腐败归因于“国民劣根性”的文化/准生物学解释，论证腐败是殖民时期关键节点形成的制度遗产——西班牙殖民确立、美国殖民强化而非拆除的五项制度遗产，导致当代菲律宾民主形式与寡头实质并存，反腐败需指向结构性变革而非个体道德。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾制度性腐败为何持续存在？其历史制度根源是什么？
AI.motivation: 反驳将菲律宾腐败归因于“国民性”的文化决定论和准生物学解释，主张腐败是制度遗产的路径依赖结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史制度主义；Acemoglu & Robinson (2012) 的榨取性制度框架；政治市场（patronage）的客户主义路径。
AI.method: 比较历史分析：殖民行政档案与菲律宾国家形态形成的二手史学文献。
AI.findings: 五项制度遗产可追溯：政治王朝、庇护网络、土地改革失败、区域财政依附、教会对政策的影响。美国改革叠加于既有榨取性安排之上，产生民主形式-寡头实质的混合政体。
AI.theory_contributions: 将历史制度主义和路径依赖理论应用于东南亚腐败研究，批判文化决定论，论证殖民制度遗产的持续性。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出反腐败应针对帝国继承下来的制度架构而非个体道德，为政策制定提供结构性改革方向。

title: The Impact of Social Entitlements and Ethicality on the Perception of Impolite Encounters: A Contrastive Study of TrustPilot Reviews
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Impact of Social Entitlements and Ethicality on the Perception of Impolite Encounters: A Contrastive Study of TrustPilot Reviews
detail.abstract: Among the most prevalent online communicative practices in the 21st century is the posting of online consumer reviews, often used as a channel for dissatisfied users. However, further research is needed into the psychosocial factors that lead customers to feel dissatisfied or disadvantaged. Against this backdrop, this study examines how social entitlements and ethical concerns shape perceptions of impoliteness in negative reviews posted on the outsourced platform Trustpilot. A corpus of 1,000 Spanishlanguage reviews was compiled, comprising 200 reviews for each of five companies differing in business model (business-to-consumer or peer-to-peer) and product orientation (good or experience oriented): Airbnb, Miravia, Ryanair, Wallapop and Zara. Our Quantitative coding identifies the frequency and distribution of rapport triggers related to sociality rights and ethical evaluations, while our qualitative analysis explores how these triggers are thematically realised and combined within the reviewers’ narratives. The findings show that costbenefit concerns and autonomyimposition issues are central to users’ negative evaluations across companies, but their relative salience and interactional framing vary depending on platform type and product orientation. Ethical judgements, often linked to perceived dishonesty, lack of transparency or neglect of customer welfare, cooccur with breaches of sociality rights and intensify the perception of impoliteness. Overall, the study demonstrates that perceived mismanagement of social entitlements and ethicality are crucial dimensions of rapport in online review discourse and offer insight into how users negotiate expectations of what is ”right” or ”wrong” in institutionalised service encounters on digital platforms.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于1,000条西班牙语负面在线评论，分析用户如何在Trustpilot平台通过社会权利（社交权）和伦理评判来构建不礼貌感知。研究发现，成本收益关切与自主性强加问题是负面评价的核心，但不同商业模式（B2C vs P2P）和产品类型（商品 vs 体验）下，两者的显著性和互动框架存在差异。伦理评判（如不诚实、缺乏透明度）与社会权利侵犯共同出现，加剧不礼貌感知。
AI.research_question: 社会权利和伦理关切如何塑造用户对负面评论中不礼貌行为的感知？不同商业模式和产品类型下，这些因素如何变化？
AI.motivation: 在线消费者评论是21世纪常见的沟通实践，尤其是不满用户的重要渠道，但导致用户感到不满或处于劣势的社会心理因素仍需进一步研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会权利（sociality rights，包括公平权、自主权等）与伦理评价（ethical evaluations）相结合的礼貌/不礼貌理论框架。
AI.method: 混合方法：定量编码分析1,000条西班牙语负面评论（5家公司各200条，涵盖B2C/P2P和商品/体验不同组合）中社交触发词的频率与分布；定性分析这些触发词在评论叙事中的主题实现与组合方式。
AI.findings: 1) 成本收益关切与自主性强加是跨公司的核心负面评价要素；2) 两者的显著性和互动框架因平台类型（B2C vs P2P）和产品导向（商品 vs 体验）而异；3) 伦理评判（不诚实、缺乏透明度、忽视客户福利）与社会权利侵犯共现，加剧不礼貌感知。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了社会权利的管理不当和伦理性是线上评论话语中关系管理的关键维度，揭示了用户在数字化平台制度化服务接触中如何协商什么是"对"或"错"的期望。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助企业理解不同商业模式和产品类型下用户负面评价的核心触发因素，从而更有针对性地改进服务、提升沟通透明度和客户公平感。

title: Social Media Toxicity and Mental Health
affiliations: , University of Barcelona - Institut d'Economia de Barcelona (IEB),  and University of Warwick

detail.title: Social Media Toxicity and Mental Health
detail.abstract: We study whether content-level moderation that reduces exposure to social media toxicity, holding platform access constant, affects mental health. We deploy, for randomly assigned users, a cross-platform browser extension that hides posts and comments exceeding a prespecified toxicity threshold, and follow N = 664 desktop users over a six-week intervention across two waves-one during the 2024 U.S. election campaign and one outside of it. Contrary to basic intuition, filtering toxicity worsens mental health: treatment raises a standardized index of GAD-7 and PHQ-8 symptoms by 0.15σ, and the share of respondents above a moderate-symptom screening cutoff rises by about 12 pp. A QALY-based calibration implies a welfare cost of about $158 per treated participant. Heightened loneliness and a diminished relative moral self-view emerge as potential channels. We conclude that curbing toxic content can impose unintended psychological costs, even where it yields other social benefits.

AI.tldr: 一项随机实验发现，过滤社交媒体上的有毒内容（毒性帖子）反而会恶化用户的心理健康，表现为焦虑和抑郁症状增加、孤独感上升以及道德自我认知下降。
AI.research_question: 减少社交媒体中的有毒内容暴露（同时保持平台访问权不变）是否会影响用户的心理健康？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体毒性内容对心理健康的负面影响已被广泛讨论，但现有研究大多关注完全戒断社交媒体的效果，而非在保留平台使用的前提下进行内容层面的过滤。作者试图填补这一空白，检验内容级温和干预的真实心理后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社交媒体使用与心理健康的关系；道德自我认知理论；社会比较与孤独感理论。
AI.method: 跨平台浏览器扩展程序，随机分配用户隐藏超过预设毒性阈值的帖子和评论；N=664名桌面用户；6周干预；两波实验（2024年美国大选期间与非选举期）。
AI.findings: 过滤毒性内容反而恶化了心理健康：标准化GAD-7和PHQ-8症状指数上升0.15σ；中度症状筛查阈值以上的受访者比例增加约12个百分点；QALY校准显示每位参与者福利成本约158美元；孤独感增加和道德自我认知下降是潜在机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了“减少有毒内容必然改善心理健康”的直觉假设，揭示了内容级温和可能产生 unintended psychological costs；提出孤独感与道德自我认知变化作为解释机制，丰富了对社交媒体与心理健康关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社交媒体平台的内容审核策略提供警示：单纯过滤有毒内容可能带来意想不到的心理成本，平台需要更审慎地设计干预措施；对政策制定者和心理健康干预者具有实践参考价值。

title: Hybrid Staging and Gendered Access to Digital Equity
affiliations: University of Essex - Essex Business School,  and University of Bergamo

detail.title: Hybrid Staging and Gendered Access to Digital Equity
detail.abstract: Digital equity platforms are often viewed as alternatives to traditional entrepreneurial finance. We show instead that they frequently extend relationships formed in private capital markets. We develop the concept of hybrid digital staging, in which a venture enters its first equity crowdfunding campaign after one or more private equity rounds and with the continued involvement of prior investors. Using 789 initial campaigns launched on Crowdcube and matched to Beauhurst financing records, we find that 64% of classifiable ventures had completed at least one private round before entering the platform. Because platforms cannot negotiate individualized contracts with dispersed investors, information accumulated during the private phase may instead be reflected in campaign design. Conditional on pre-campaign observables, hybrid staging is associated with funding goals approximately two-thirds higher than those of otherwise comparable ventures. Goals also increase with the depth of the prior financing relationship: by about 22% for each additional private round and 27% for each additional year of staging history. This pattern is more consistent with information accumulated through repeated financing and monitoring than with a purely dichotomous certification effect. Access to this pathway is uneven and state contingent. Female-led ventures are about 10 percentage points less likely to enter crowdfunding with prior staging; this gap is indistinguishable from zero outside the COVID-19 period but rises to roughly 25 percentage points during it. Digital equity platforms therefore extend the reach of the private financing system, carrying both accumulated private information and inequalities in access into digital equity markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了股权众筹平台并非替代传统私人资本市场，而是延伸了已有私人融资关系。通过对Crowdcube平台789个初始众筹活动的分析，发现64%的创业公司在进入众筹前已完成了至少一轮私募融资。基于此提出"混合数字分阶段融资"概念，并发现融资目标与前期私募轮次数量和时长正相关，同时女性领导的企业进入该路径的可能性更低，尤其在疫情期间差距更大。
AI.research_question: 数字股权平台是否真正替代了传统私募融资？股权众筹活动如何受到前期私募融资关系的影响？
AI.motivation: 数字股权平台通常被视为传统创业融资（如私募股权）的替代方案，但现实中大量创业公司在进入众筹前已有私募融资经历。作者希望揭示平台与私人资本市场的真实关系，而非简单将其视为替代品。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合数字分阶段融资（Hybrid Digital Staging）：创业公司在完成一轮或多轮私募融资后，在先前投资者持续参与下进入首次股权众筹的融资模式。信息累积理论：前期私募阶段积累的信息因平台无法与分散投资者逐一谈判，转而反映在众筹活动设计中。
AI.method: 使用Crowdcube平台789个初始众筹活动数据，匹配Beauhurst融资记录，进行计量回归分析，检验融资目标与前期融资轮次、时长等变量的关系，并分析性别差异。
AI.findings: 1. 64%的可分类创业公司在进入众筹前已完成至少一轮私募融资。2. 混合数字分阶段融资的创业公司融资目标比同类公司高约三分之二。3. 每增加一轮私募轮次，融资目标提高约22%；每增加一年分期融资历史，目标提高约27%。4. 女性领导的企业进行混合数字分阶段融资的可能性低约10个百分点，疫情期间差距扩大至约25个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"混合数字分阶段融资"新概念，挑战了数字平台完全替代传统融资的既有观点，揭示了数字平台是私人资本市场的延伸而非替代，并阐明前期信息积累如何通过活动设计传递而非通过一对一谈判。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者和投资者理解股权众筹平台的实际运作机制提供了实证依据，揭示了数字市场中不平等获取融资路径的问题，对政策制定者关注数字融资平台的公平性具有启示意义。

title: From priority ordering to scaling: A two-phase procedure for facility search in Japanese rehabilitation team interaction
affiliations: National Defense Academy of Japan

detail.title: From priority ordering to scaling: A two-phase procedure for facility search in Japanese rehabilitation team interaction
detail.abstract: Building on a line of inquiry that Sacks identified but left undeveloped—namely, the search for professional help—the present study draws on Bilmes’s frameworks of first priority response/mention and occasioned semantics analysis of scaling to provide a systematic account of the two-phase procedure through which suitable care facilities are identified in interprofessional discharge planning for stroke patients whose family caregivers are unavailable to provide care. Using naturally occurring conversational data from Japanese rehabilitation team meetings, it investigates: (1) how institutional criteria are occasioned as relevant and prioritized in interaction and (2) how participants manage the prioritized constraints through regrading. The analysis shows that, in the first phase, participants treat inflexible criteria—financial constraints and required care level—as first-priority matters before proceeding to more flexible criteria. Where necessary, they establish the procedural basis for the second phase through formulation practices, including maximal boundaries, scaling and contrast, and category attributions. In the second phase, participants accomplish facility selection by fitting placement options to the prioritized constraints through regrading. The analysis further demonstrates that, on some occasions, participants treat the prior non-mention of an inflexible criterion as accountable, showing that the relevance of the omitted criterion is displayed through participants’ actions. By providing a systematic interactional account of this two-phase procedure, the study extends Bilmes’s frameworks to interprofessional decision-making, demonstrating that priority ordering and scaling in discharge planning are institutionally constituted through participants’ ongoing collaborative actions.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于Sacks未充分发展的"寻求专业帮助"线索，运用Bilmes的优先回应/提及理论和场合语义学中的分级分析框架，系统探讨了日本康复团队会议中，当脑卒中患者家属无法提供照护时，跨专业团队如何通过两阶段程序识别合适的护理机构。第一阶段，参与者优先处理刚性标准（经济限制和所需照护水平），然后才转向更灵活的标准；必要时通过边界设定、分级对比和类别归属等实践为第二阶段建立程序基础。第二阶段，参与者通过重新分级将安置选项匹配到优先约束条件。研究还发现，参与者会将先前未提及的刚性标准视为可问责的，表明遗漏标准的关联性通过参与者行动得以展现。该研究将Bilmes框架扩展到跨专业决策领域，证明出院规划中的优先排序和分级是通过参与者持续的协作行动在制度上构成的。
AI.research_question: 跨专业出院规划中，当脑卒中患者家属无法提供照护时，参与者如何通过互动识别合适的护理设施？具体包括：(1) 制度标准如何在互动中被引发并优先排序？(2) 参与者如何通过重新分级管理优先约束条件？
AI.motivation: Sacks曾指出"寻求专业帮助"这一研究线索但未充分展开，本研究旨在填补这一空白，并进一步推进Bilmes的优先回应理论和场合语义学分析框架在机构互动中的应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: Bilmes的优先回应/提及理论（first priority response/mention）和场合语义学中的分级分析（occasioned semantics analysis of scaling）
AI.method: 基于日本康复团队会议的自然发生的对话录音数据，采用会话分析（Conversation Analysis）方法
AI.findings: (1) 护理设施识别遵循两阶段程序：第一阶段优先处理刚性标准（经济限制、所需照护水平），第二阶段通过重新分级将选项匹配到约束条件。(2) 参与者通过边界设定、分级对比、类别归属等阐述实践建立阶段转换的基础。(3) 未提及的刚性标准会被参与者视为可问责的，其关联性通过后续行动得以展现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Bilmes的优先回应/提及理论和分级分析框架从日常对话扩展到机构性跨专业决策情境，证明出院规划中的优先排序和分级是参与者协作行动在制度层面的构成性产物。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示跨专业团队在实际互动中如何协商和排序决策标准，为优化出院规划流程、提升护理设施匹配效率和质量提供互动层面的实践洞见。

title: Liquidation Without Loss: A Live-Book Decomposition of Aave v3
affiliations: UNIP - Universidade Paulista

detail.title: Liquidation Without Loss: A Live-Book Decomposition of Aave v3

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares the following competing interest: Bitquery and CoinGecko supported this work by providing in-kind access to their data APIs, which supplied the event logs and the price marks used in the study. Neither provider had any role in the study design, the data analysis, the interpretation of the results, or the decision to submit the work for publication, and neither reviewed the manuscript prior to submission. The author reports no other financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported here.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, their identifiable data, or animals. It relies solely on publicly available on-chain blockchain records and public market price data. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. Bitquery and CoinGecko provided in-kind access to their data APIs for the purpose of data acquisition. This support did not extend to the study design, the analysis, or the decision to publish.

detail.abstract: In a looped DeFi lending book, the figure a stress test flags as "at-risk" is liquidationeligible debt, and it is separated from the protocol's protocol bad debt by two distinct gaps that we measure separately. First, eligible debt is not executed volume: under a partial close factor a position is liquidated in parts and re-buffers, so at a 5% de-peg the $1.36B of eligible debt in the live loop cluster produces about $0.69B of executed repayment and $0.72B of seized collateral, not $1.36B of selling. Second, executed volume is not protocol bad debt: a loop is liquidated under the parameters of the mode it is held in, and when its liquidation threshold and bonus satisfy LT (1+b) < 1, a loop that crosses HF = 1 on a continuous price path is removed while its collateral still covers the bonus-grossed debt, so the protocol books no bad debt at any de-peg depth. Aave v3 satisfies this invariant in every e-mode category: the ETH-correlated category that carries the liquid-staking loops is LT 0.95 with a 1% liquidation bonus (the category bonus, read from the Pool contract, not the 6% wstETH reserve bonus), giving LT (1+b) = 0.9595; reaching the loss-on-crossing regime would require a bonus above 5.26%, five times what Aave sets, and all eight live e-mode categories carry a comparable margin. On one live Aave-v3 Ethereum block (17,419 borrowers, $6.5B debt), a 5% de-peg of the liquid-staking slice therefore flags $1.38B as liquidation-eligible while the continuous-path protocol bad debt is $0 (the pure-loop core carries $1.36B of that eligible debt at $0 bad debt; the 1.76% mixed-collateral remainder is discussed in the body). This $0 is not an empirical robustness finding but a consequence of the LT (1+b) < 1 invariant on an unbroken continuous path (a loop removed at its solvent crossing books nothing at any glide depth), so the load-bearing risk analysis is the boundary D * and the channels that break the path, below, not the depth of the de-peg. We characterize the boundary in closed form, D * = max 1-1/HF 0 , 1-(1+b)LT /HF 0 , matched to a cascade engine to one grid step; for the live e-mode anchor D * = 7.4%, and its median across the live slice is 6.9% (8.8% debt-weighted). Protocol bad debt appears only when something breaks the continuous path, and we size each channel on the live cluster: a discrete price gap (a jump no liquidator can step through) books $0.1M at a 5% gap but $47M at 10%; partial liquidation into a finite $2B pool books $3.0M at a 5% gap where full liquidation books $0; measured June-2022 oracle staleness adds up to $5M at an 8% gap; and secondary-market depth sets the magnitude past the boundary ($30M at infinite depth rising to $0.70B at a $1B pool for a 15% gap). A reflexive de-peg, in which the forced selling moves the peg itself, runs the peg to near-total collapse with the redemption queue frozen, yet still books $0 because the loops exit solvent as the peg runs away; a live withdrawal backstop is the control, not the threshold. Three real episodes are consistent with the invariant: pre-event Aave-v2 stETH/WETH (−6.8%) and the March-2023 USDC pin both reconstruct to $0, and the March-2026 Aave CAPO event liquidated ≈$26M of wstETH e-mode with no protocol bad debt. We are precise throughout that zero protocol bad debt is not zero economic cost: the same episodes transfer value to liquidators (the bonus), impose losses on the liquidated borrowers, and can trigger DAO compensation; our claim is about the protocol’s balance sheet, not borrower or third-party welfare. The operative controls are therefore oracle-deviation and heartbeat bounds, supply caps, and the withdrawal backstop, not the liquidation threshold. The directional-crash overstatement (6.53× at −5%) is a netting convention, not book risk. We formalize a mechanism recent Aave e-mode liquidations have already shown in the wild, not claim to discover it.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，在Aave v3的循环DeFi借贷中，协议坏账为零并非偶然的实证发现，而是由LT(1+b) < 1这一数学不变式决定的：当清算阈值与清算奖励满足该条件时，循环借贷在连续价格路径上被清算时，抵押品始终足以覆盖债务及其奖励，因此不会产生协议坏账。真正的风险边界在于打破连续路径的离散因素——价格跳跃、流动性深度、预言机滞后等。
AI.research_question: 在Aave v3循环借贷中，当抵押品（如stETH）发生脱锚时，协议层面的坏账风险究竟有多大？风险边界在哪里？
AI.motivation: 市场普遍高估DeFi借贷协议在脱锚事件中的坏账风险（例如将"清算合格债务"等同于"协议坏账"），忽略了清算机制和参数设计中的结构性保护。作者旨在纠正这一误解，量化真实风险来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Aave v3的e-mode参数设计（LT=0.95, b=1%），推导出LT(1+b)=0.9595 < 1的不变式。在连续价格路径下，循环借贷在HF=1穿越点时抵押品仍大于债务+奖励，因此协议零坏账。同时给出边界D*的闭式解。
AI.method: 理论推导 + 实证校准：对Aave v3以太坊上一个实际区块（17,419个借款人，65亿美元债务）进行压力测试，结合级联引擎模拟不同脱锚深度下的清算执行、坏账产生，并量化四种打破连续路径的通道（价格跳跃、部分清算、预言机滞后、二级市场深度）的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 5%脱锚时，13.6亿美元清算合格债务中实际执行约6.9亿美元还款，协议坏账为零；2) LT(1+b) < 1保证连续路径下零坏账；3) 真实风险边界D*=7.4%（锚定e-mode），中位数6.9%；4) 价格跳跃10%才产生4700万美元坏账；5) 2022年6月预言机滞后最多仅500万美元损失；6) 即使发生反身性脱锚（质押品价格因强制清算而进一步下跌），由于循环借贷在peg逃逸过程中仍能保本退出，协议坏账仍为零。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地揭示了Aave v3 e-mode参数设计中的LT(1+b) < 1不变式如何从数学上保证循环借贷在连续价格路径下协议坏账为零，并给出了风险边界D*的闭式解。将"协议坏账"与"清算合格债务"、"执行清算量"明确区分为三个独立变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Aave等DeFi协议的风险管理者提供了可操作的边界量（D*）和风险通道排序（价格跳跃 > 流动性深度 > 预言机滞后），指出真正的控制变量不是清算阈值，而是预言机偏差/心跳限制、供应上限和提款后援机制。纠正了市场中6.53倍的脱锚风险高估。

title: A Case Analysis of Judgment Update Deficiency: Taking Xiao Yan, Protagonist of Battle Through the Heavens, as the Research Subject
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Case Analysis of Judgment Update Deficiency: Taking Xiao Yan, Protagonist of Battle Through the Heavens, as the Research Subject
detail.abstract:
(1) Research Purpose: Taking Xiao Yan, protagonist of Battle Through the Heavens, as a case subject, this study investigates Judgment Update Deficiency (JUD)-a cognitive dysfunction characterized by an inability to revise judgments based on new information. JUD is conceptualized not as a single bias but as a Self-Reinforcing Judgment Loop comprising four failed nodes: Initial Representation, Update Lockout, Consistency Maintenance, and Boundary Recognition Failure. 
(2) Research Design/Method: A case analysis of the full forty-volume text is conducted, comparing judgment behaviors across combat and non-combat domains. Analytical tools include Naturalistic Decision Making, Ecological Rationality, Signal Detection Theory, and Social Judgment Theory. The Yun Yun incident serves as the core case; the Medusa case delimits the theoretical boundary between Evaluation Update and Strategic Reclassification. 
(3) Research Results: The subject's judgment system operates as a closed loop: binary classification (Initial Representation), failure of new interpersonal information to trigger re-evaluation (Update Lockout), compensatory consistency maintenance, and cross-domain proliferation of combat logic (Boundary Recognition Failure). The Medusa case demonstrates that the loop permits Strategic Reclassification but precludes Evaluation Update. Sensitivity analysis shows that a single evaluation update event could reduce JUD by approximately 50%, yet none occurred across the forty volumes. 
(4) Limitations: Only one fictional character is analyzed; future research may expand the sample. 
(5) Implications: A four-node diagnostic framework is proposed for identifying JUD tendencies. 
(6) Originality: This study is the first to model JUD as a Self-Reinforcing Judgment Loop, to distinguish Evaluation Update from Strategic Reclassification, and to establish a replicable analytical pathway using a fictional case.

AI.tldr: 本文以《斗破苍穹》主角萧炎为案例，研究"判断更新缺陷"（JUD）这一认知功能障碍，将其建模为包含四个失败节点的自我强化判断循环，并通过全书四十卷文本分析揭示了其判断系统的闭环运作机制。
AI.research_question: 以萧炎为案例，判断更新缺陷（JUD）这一认知功能障碍在个体判断系统中如何运作？其内在机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现实中个体常出现无法根据新信息修正判断的认知偏差，但现有研究缺乏对这一现象的整合性理论模型。选取虚构角色萧炎作为极端案例，可清晰观察JUD的完整运作链条。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自然主义决策、生态理性、信号检测理论、社会判断理论
AI.method: 对《斗破苍穹》全书四十卷文本进行案例分析，比较战斗与非战斗领域的判断行为。以云韵事件为核心案例，以美杜莎事件界定"评估更新"与"策略重分类"的理论边界。
AI.findings: 萧炎的判断系统是一个闭环：初始表征的二元分类→新人际信息无法触发重新评估（更新锁定）→补偿性一致性维护→战斗逻辑跨领域扩散（边界识别失败）。美杜莎案例表明该循环允许策略重分类但阻止评估更新。敏感度分析显示，单次评估更新事件可使JUD降低约50%，但全书四十卷中未发生任何一次。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将JUD建模为自我强化判断循环；首次区分"评估更新"与"策略重分类"；建立了使用虚构案例进行可复现分析的新路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出四节点诊断框架，用于识别判断更新缺陷倾向。

title: The Bharat Wellness Index: A Panchakosha-Based Framework for Measuring and Improving Organisational and Societal Wellbeing
